categories.main_business_segments: Fulin Precision Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: automotive engine parts manufacturing, new energy vehicle (NEV) intelligent electronic control components, and lithium-ion battery cathode materials production. The company also extends into precision components for robotics, focusing on intelligent electric joint modules. Its automotive parts include precision hydraulic and electromagnetic components for engines and transmissions, while its NEV segment covers smart thermal management systems, electric drive reducers, and intelligent suspension components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision manufacturing technologies including deep blind hole processing, laser automatic welding, and high-precision gear shaft production. It employs solid-phase and ferrous oxalate processes for high-density lithium iron phosphate cathode materials, emphasizing high compaction density, high capacity, and long cycle life. The production methods integrate lean manufacturing, automation, and digitalization to enhance efficiency and quality, with a strong focus on R&D in micro-motor technology, electronic control, and software development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Fulin serves over 60 OEM customers domestically and internationally, including major Chinese automakers such as BYD, SAIC, Geely, Great Wall, Changan, and new energy vehicle leaders like NIO, Li Auto, and XPeng. It also supplies international OEMs including Volkswagen, General Motors, Ford, Toyota, and Renault. The company’s products cater to passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and emerging markets in Europe, North America, India, Southeast Asia, and Latin America. Its lithium battery materials are supplied to leading battery manufacturers like CATL.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and main manufacturing bases in Mianyang, Sichuan Province. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Europe and other regions, including a manufacturing presence in France. Its sales and supply chain extend globally, with significant export activities to Europe, North America, and emerging markets. The lithium battery materials business also targets international markets through strategic partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fulin operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive and lithium battery supply chains. It manufactures critical precision components for automotive engines, transmissions, and new energy vehicle powertrains, as well as producing cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries. The company is a key Tier 1 supplier to OEMs and battery manufacturers, integrating R&D, manufacturing, and direct sales to vehicle and battery producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on accelerating the transition to new energy and intelligent vehicles by expanding its NEV intelligent electronic control systems and lithium battery cathode materials. It prioritizes R&D in smart thermal management, electric drive systems, intelligent suspension, and high-density lithium iron phosphate materials. Fulin is also developing robotics electric joint modules and advancing product innovation to enhance performance, reduce costs, and expand application scenarios. It emphasizes lean management, digital transformation, and deepening strategic partnerships with industry leaders like CATL and Huawei.
categories.revenue_model: Fulin generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive precision parts, new energy vehicle electronic components, and lithium battery cathode materials. The company operates on a product sales model with contracts and orders from OEMs and battery manufacturers. It also engages in export sales and provides technical services related to product development and customization. Revenue is recognized at the point of delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In automotive engine precision parts, Fulin competes with global suppliers such as Germany's INA, BorgWarner, Eaton, Japan's NTN and Denso, and Delphi. In the NEV components sector, it competes with international and domestic suppliers but holds a leading position in China, especially in precision hydraulic and electromagnetic components and intelligent control systems. In lithium battery cathode materials, its subsidiary Jiangxi Shenghua is a leading domestic producer of high-density lithium iron phosphate materials, competing with major battery material suppliers. The company positions itself as a technology-driven leader with strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Fulin achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.47 billion, representing a 47.02% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 396.78 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in 2023. The company’s total assets reached RMB 9.68 billion, with net assets of RMB 4.22 billion. The lithium battery cathode materials segment grew by nearly 72%, while automotive parts grew by over 23%. The company has shown strong growth momentum driven by NEV market expansion and increased production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fulin emphasizes its advanced precision manufacturing technologies, strong R&D capabilities, and integrated product solutions in automotive and new energy sectors. Its unique value lies in delivering high-quality, cost-effective, and technologically advanced precision components and lithium battery materials that meet stringent OEM requirements. The company’s proprietary high-density lithium iron phosphate technology offers superior energy density, safety, and cycle life, favored by leading battery manufacturers. Its close collaboration with top-tier customers and focus on innovation enable rapid response to market and technology trends, ensuring competitive differentiation.
